note: What a player agrees to at checkout for a coin pack. The server stores this exact text with each payment (payments.consent_text), so change `version` whenever the wording changes.
withdrawal: I want my coins delivered right away. I understand that I lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once they're delivered.
terms: I'm 18 or older, or a parent or guardian has agreed to this purchase. I accept the terms of sale.
stripeSubmit: By paying you ask for your coins to be delivered right away and agree that your 14-day right of withdrawal ends once they're delivered.
